callees.name: load_call_edges
callees.pre_condition: extra_call_edges_path is either None or a filesystem path to a JSON file
callees.post_condition: Returns a list of CallEdge records parsed from the file at extra_call_edges_path. Returns an empty list when extra_call_edges_path is None.

callees.name: _select_functions_by_source
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is an existing directory. entry_func is a non-empty FQN string. extra_call_edges is a list of CallEdge records, possibly empty.
callees.post_condition: Returns a pair (all_by_source, keep_by_source) where all_by_source maps each source file path to all function names extracted from that file, and keep_by_source maps each source file path to the subset of those function names that lie on directed call-graph paths from entry_func to some FQN in end_funcs. When end_funcs is None or empty, keep_by_source contains all functions reachable from entry_func.

callees.name: _make_run_copy
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is an existing directory. run_dir is a filesystem path that does not exist or is the path to a prior resumed run.
callees.post_condition: run_dir exists and contains a copy of proj_dir's source tree and any pre-existing fm_agent/ workspace found in proj_dir.

callees.name: try_codegraph_init
callees.post_condition: If the codegraph indexing tool is installed in the environment, a codegraph index covering source files under run_dir has been built. If the tool is not installed, no action has been taken and no error has been raised.

callees.name: _trim_project_in_place
callees.pre_condition: run_dir contains a full project copy. all_by_source and keep_by_source are the dicts returned by _select_functions_by_source.
callees.post_condition: For every source file listed in all_by_source, the file under run_dir has been modified so that only the functions named in keep_by_source for that file remain present. Functions present in all_by_source but absent from keep_by_source for a given file have been removed from that file. Files not appearing in all_by_source are left unchanged.

callees.name: run_pipeline
callees.signature: run_pipeline(run_dir, resume, required_source_files, domain_knowledge_files, one_phase, extra_call_edges_path, only_spec, bug_validator_path, plugin_config)
callees.pre_condition: run_dir is an existing directory containing a trimmed project. resume is a boolean. required_source_files is a list of source file paths relative to run_dir.
callees.post_condition: The full 6-stage FM-Agent pipeline has been executed on the project at run_dir, producing behavioral specifications, reasoning verdicts, and bug-validation reports under run_dir/fm_agent/. The source files listed in required_source_files are included in the generated phases plan regardless of whether the setup agent would otherwise include or omit them.

callees.name: _entry_func_source_rel
callees.pre_condition: entry_func is a non-empty FQN string
callees.post_condition: Returns the source file path relative to the project root that contains the function identified by entry_func

callees.name: _count_mismatches
callees.post_condition: Returns an integer count of reasoning-verdict files under results_dir whose verdict field equals the literal string 'MISMATCH'. Returns 0 when results_dir does not exist.
